"Sugar Skull Cash" is down to one top prize after a $100,000 winner was claimed in this morning's update. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

If you play "Sugar Skull Cash" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2773.headline: A top prize was just claimed

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" has joined the Texas lineup at $10 with four top prizes of $250,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything here about "The Price is Right™" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through October 14.
